NOTE: BBC News live (20 Jul 2026) — Healey Chancellor, Miliband Foreign Sec, Mahmood stays Home Sec, Haigh Duchy of Lancaster. Quotes from Miliband, Mahmood, Healey.
Ed Miliband to BBC's Chris Mason: it is the "honour of my life" to serve as foreign secretary; "My parents came here as Jewish refugees fleeing from the Nazis... Britain provided sanctuary and a beacon of hope in the fight against fascism."
Shabana Mahmood on X: "I may be biased, but it's the best job in the business. We have begun the work of major reform, to make our streets safer and our immigration system fair for all. Now let's finish the job."
John Healey on X: appointment is the "greatest privilege"; "Together, we will build a new economy, build new hope and advance the working people of this country... Time to get on with the job."
Burnham invited Trump to Manchester during a call; underlined "his commitment to defence and security".
11 who sat around Starmer's cabinet table sacked or left.
